title: Salon rowerowy

requirements.heading: Operacje na bazie danych
requirements.coverage: Create rowery with Polish collation, import rowery.sql (producenci 6, rowery 224), full-screen import.png.

requirements.heading: Operacje na bazie danych
requirements.coverage: Mountain bikes up to 4500 (9 rows Fuse Comp 22..Roscoe 6); MIN/AVG/MAX per producer with aliases via relation (6 rows); Carbon models in frame L (ids 5, 7, 13, 16, 18, 29, 52); UPDATE gravel price * 0.75 (5 rows). Verified against criteria R.1.3-R.1.6 and the data.

requirements.heading: Cechy grafiki 1.jpg
requirements.coverage: 1.jpg 1200x919 mirrored about the vertical axis and scaled proportionally to width 400 px (about 306 px high).

requirements.heading: Cechy witryny
requirements.coverage: index.html, Polish HTML5, encoding, title, styl.css; header, main, aside, two footers; five images alt rower; h1, two h2, three radios in labels with klasa_etykiety and title, first checked; range 100-220 value 150; number 150; Sprawdź with klasa_etykiety; result paragraph; aside h1 and five paragraphs with classes in one attribute; footer h4 lists with a nested list in the first item; 2x2 table with number and date cell.

requirements.heading: Styl CSS witryny internetowej
requirements.coverage: body 80% margin auto; header fixed top 0, 200 px, white, centred; main 60% 650 px padding left/right 2% margin-top 200 px; aside 20% 650 px shadow 0 0 100px #02220a margin-top 200 px; footers 50% 170 px #02220a white; img 16% margin 8 padding 3 radius 50%; .klasa_etykiety box with ForestGreen hover; .logo1, .logo2, .prawa, .srodek; ul without markers.

requirements.heading: Skrypty działające po stronie klienta
requirements.coverage: Script 1 copies the range value to the number field; script 2 checks .checked, multiplies height by 0.26/0.3/0.28, divides by 2.54, rounds and prints the paper's sentence; script 3 creates Date and shows DD.MM.RRRR in the footer. No runtime adapter: checked manually.

requirements.heading: UWAGA: po zakończeniu pracy
requirements.coverage: przegladarka.txt (spelled without ę in this paper), listed result files and disc hand-in.
